say:0:1620985801:1.text: A coffin usually holds a body, or what can stand in its place if there is no body. Your recipe could serve as a substitute for what should have been inside. So the one who was "buried" here... was you?
say:0:1620985801:1.source_cn: 棺材中通常会存放逝者的遗体，但如果没有遗体，会以遗物替...
